svg.title: Predicted vs experimental phase fractions in Ca–Si–P–O glass-ceramics
svg.desc: Parity plot and residual strip plot for wollastonite, hydroxyapatite and whitlockite on a held-out test set; R2 = 0.933, RMSE = 2.08 wt%.
svg.text: Held-out test set · Ca–Si–P–O bioactive glass-ceramics · wollastonite, hydroxyapatite, whitlockite
Random 20% row hold-out · n = 15 (5 per phase)
Phase fractions in wt%. Points are from a random 20% row split; shape and colour distinguish phases (colour-blind-safe Okabe–Ito palette).
The ±RMSE band is a reference for typical error, not a confidence interval.
